correctness.rationale: For each omitted rung/horizontal edge, exactly one adjacent selected edge gives three explicit bit implications. An independently generated directed graph on 64 ordered column-pairs has exactly 102 arcs. Its start-to-terminal productive part has 14 states; verified all 14 successor rows and found exactly one directed six-cycle (1→13→40→2→22→48→1) plus the full-edge loop at 63. Start–exit path residues modulo six yield 2,2,4,2,2,4 proper labelled PED sets by n mod6 and one full set, giving z^(3n−2)+(2+2I[n≡2 mod3])z^n for n≥2, L1=z. Cyclic configurations are closed length-n walks, giving z^(3n)+6I[6|n]z^n for n≥3. Direct independent edge-subset enumeration confirmed all open n≤6 and circular 3≤n≤6; this checks small cases, whereas the exhaustive 64-state graph reduction proves all n. The proper configurations have adjacent selected edges, ruling out DIM.
